title: NativeApprovalNotifications
responsibility: Polls the approved Mac account for new device requests and suppresses repeated prompts and stale responses.

inputs.name: NativeApprovalNotifications.constructor.auth
inputs.description: The native account status and the approval inbox for the current installation.

inputs.name: NativeApprovalNotifications.constructor.notify
inputs.description: Optional callback for a generic notification when a request first appears.

outputs.name: NativeApprovalNotifications.refresh
outputs.description: Refreshes account status and prompts once for requests that are new to the current account.
